newsitem.title: USA: OEC Med gets FDA low-cost mobile C-arm ok.
newsitem.headline: OEC Med gets FDA low-cost mobile C-arm ok.

text.p: OEC Medical Systems Inc said on Tuesday that it has received 510K approval from the U.S. Food & Drug Administration to begin marketing its new Series 7600 Mobile C-arm product in the United States, effective immediately.
The Series 7600 is designed to provide basic full-sized imaging capabilities in a lower priced product than its Compact 7600.
OEC said that it is similar to the Compact 7600 except it has a separate monitor cart which offers greater image storage capacity, hard-copy film documentation and dual monitor capability.
